headline: 4 Stellar Soroban contracts catalogued (1 escrow, 3 vaults) from Zellic deployment-verification section; admin actor class unknown pending on-chain read; no EVM-format addresses available.

findings.text: D1: Stellar does not have a block explorer that accepts 0x EVM name-tag searches. Stellar Expert (stellar.expert) is the canonical explorer for Soroban contracts using C-address strkeys. No EVM block explorer is applicable. Attempted web search for Stellar DeFi Hub / Sentora on explorer yielded no direct explorer page fetched; addresses were instead recovered from the May 2026 Zellic deployment-verification section (§4.1). D1-offchain: on-chain explorer fetch not performed — Stellar strkey addresses are not supported by defipunkd read-API (chainId not in supported list: 1,10,56,130,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144,81457,534352,11155111).

D2: Website (stellardefihub.com) returned only meta-tag content — no deployed contracts page discovered. No docs subdomain or /deployments path was found in this run. Deployed contract addresses sourced from the May 2026 Zellic audit §4.1 instead.

D3: Both audit PDFs fetched in full. Dec 2025 audit covers Vault + Escrow at commit b4b61b46, scope: vault/src/**.rs and escrow/src/**.rs. May 2026 audit covers Pre-deposit Program at commit a7955fcb (incremental from 7913968), deployed at commit c29a8bf9. §4.1 lists 4 deployed Stellar strkey addresses verified by Zellic against compiled WASM: escrow CCZSNGVMEHRKMMMQGVDHAXT3KSWIMPEPRRTUE2GU3F6TW4XA2Y6EMHN3, XLM vault CA54LVHMAY7HGLMVPN4W72XJB4OGKVZBZX26FWN6JD4P3HJFWQUQEHJO, USDC vault CAHEWHOPPDBQYFMAOLDOXXGUX2BCR7EXP4CWYCRY3NEAJB35YPZMMJFF, PYUSD vault CAQRAXBU6G4AAX4BZ7R4WLB62TSVAQFS5ZXJDVXRLAU2NZ2ZTGU5QOYB.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults surfaced from audit scope section. Direct GitHub fetch was blocked (allowlist: only URLs from prior results). No pinned deployment artifact files could be fetched. Repo structure inferred from audit: vault/src/**.rs and escrow/src/**.rs (Dec 2025), contracts/*.rs (May 2026). Commit SHAs recorded: b4b61b46 (Dec 2025 scope), a7955fcb (May 2026 scope), c29a8bf9 (deployed).
D5: Protocol.chains is Stellar only — single chain enumeration. No multi-chain expansion needed.

D6: No factory contract identified in scope. The three vault contracts (XLM, USDC, PYUSD) appear to be individually deployed instances, not factory-produced children. No factory enumeration applicable.

D7: Four contracts classified: escrow (vault), XLM vault (vault), USDC vault (vault), PYUSD vault (vault). Admin functions in Escrow: upgrade(), withdraw(), set_rewards_root(), sweep_expired_epoch(). Admin functions in Vault: upgrade(), update_admin(), set_status(). Admin actor class is unknown — Zellic audits noted 'key custody' was out of scope and recommended multisig; remediation on centralization risk was only 'acknowledged'. The admin Stellar G-address is not disclosed in either audit.

D8: All 4 contract addresses trace to the May 2026 Zellic audit §4.1 (fetched this run). Addresses are Stellar Strkey C-format (not 0x EVM format) so they cannot populate admin_addresses[].address per schema validation rule. They are recorded in evidence[].shows. The admin G-address (who holds upgrade/withdraw power) was not disclosed in either audit and is listed in unknowns[].

rationale.verdict: Discovery run completed: 4 deployed Stellar Soroban contracts catalogued from Zellic May 2026 audit §4.1 deployment-verification section (escrow + 3 asset vaults). GitHub repo identified as Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults. Stellar strkey addresses cannot populate defipunkd admin_addresses[] schema (requires 0x EVM format) and Stellar is not a supported chainId for the read API, so grade remains unknown pending schema / tooling support for non-EVM chains.

evidence.shows: Website home page for Stellar DeFi Hub. Meta description: 'Deposit Stellar-based assets into incentivized vaults and earn rewards.' Twitter handle @StellarDeFiHub confirmed. No deployed-contracts page link found in returned content.

Zellic Dec 2025 security assessment for Sentora / Stellar Vault. Client: Tom Rogers, Sentora. Scope: GitHub repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults at commit b4b61b46273eb66855777d405b485150f29cb484, vault/src/**.rs and escrow/src/**.rs. Two components: Vault (custodial deposit/withdraw, admin: upgrade, update_admin, set_status/pause) and Escrow (Merkle-tree reward distribution, admin: upgrade, withdraw, set_rewards_root). 4 findings: 1 medium, 3 informational. Centralization risk flagged in §4.2: no guarantee funds in vault flow to escrow; admin is single point of control.

Zellic May 2026 security assessment for Sentora / Pre-deposit Program. Client: Tom Rogers, Sentora. Scope: repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults, incremental changes 7913968..a7955fc, final audit version a7955fcb72d7eb482a84d0d1cdc62c55749d3d9b, programs: contracts/*.rs. 9 findings: 0 critical, 1 high (centralization risk — admin can withdraw committed reward assets without bound), 3 medium, 1 low, 4 informational. §4.1 Deployment Verification: deployed commit c29a8bf9, WASM hashes verified by Zellic. Deployed addresses: escrow CCZSNGVMEHRKMMMQGVDHAXT3KSWIMPEPRRTUE2GU3F6TW4XA2Y6EMHN3; XLM vault CA54LVHMAY7HGLMVPN4W72XJB4OGKVZBZX26FWN6JD4P3HJFWQUQEHJO; USDC vault CAHEWHOPPDBQYFMAOLDOXXGUX2BCR7EXP4CWYCRY3NEAJB35YPZMMJFF; PYUSD vault CAQRAXBU6G4AAX4BZ7R4WLB62TSVAQFS5ZXJDVXRLAU2NZ2ZTGU5QOYB.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults not directly fetchable this run (not in allowlist). Deployment artifacts (run-latest.json, deployments/*.json) not inspected. Next run should fetch https://github.com/Into-The-Block-Corp/StellarVaults at commit c29a8bf9.

Whether admin is EOA or multisig is unknown. Zellic recommended multisig but remediation was only 'acknowledged' — not confirmed implemented.

D8: Stellar Strkey addresses (C-prefix) cannot be stored in admin_addresses[].address (schema requires 0x EVM format). Addresses recorded in evidence[] only. Schema extension needed for non-EVM chains. Stellar address format: CCZSNGVMEHRKMMMQGVDHAXT3KSWIMPEPRRTUE2GU3F6TW4XA2Y6EMHN3 (escrow), CA54LVHMAY7HGLMVPN4W72XJB4OGKVZBZX26FWN6JD4P3HJFWQUQEHJO (XLM vault), CAHEWHOPPDBQYFMAOLDOXXGUX2BCR7EXP4CWYCRY3NEAJB35YPZMMJFF (USDC vault), CAQRAXBU6G4AAX4BZ7R4WLB62TSVAQFS5ZXJDVXRLAU2NZ2ZTGU5QOYB (PYUSD vault).
D8-offchain: On-chain read of admin storage key for escrow/vault contracts not possible via defipunkd API (Stellar not a supported chainId). Admin actor class remains unknown.

protocol_metadata.about: Stellar DeFi Hub is a Soroban (Stellar)-based pre-deposit farming platform operated by Sentora, an institutional DeFi platform built in partnership with Ultra Stellar. Users deposit Stellar-native assets (XLM, USDC, PYUSD) into incentivized custodial vaults to accrue epoch-based rewards. Rewards are distributed via a Merkle-tree escrow contract where users claim their allocation with cryptographic proofs. The protocol consists of two contract types — Vault (deposit/withdraw custody) and Escrow (Merkle reward distribution) — with a single admin holding upgrade and fund-withdrawal authority over both.
